jobs.title: Nurse Practitioner
jobs.summary: Nurse Practitioner at Auburn Community Hospital. Setting: pediatric emergency.
jobs.description:
GENERAL SUMMARY:

The nurse practitioner (NP) will assist in medical care of office patients in the outpatient setting as outlined in the Principal Duties and responsibilities below and will participate in all aspects of patient care as indicated. The NP will also have direct reporting responsibility to the Attending Physician of the respective patients for all evaluations and other duties performed.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

May provide direct care to patients.

Demonstrate the ability to problem-solve, analyze exiting programs, and apply process improvement principles.

Examine patients to obtain information about their physical condition.

Make tentative diagnosis and decisions about management and the patient

Obtain, compile and record patient medical data, including health notes and results of physical examination

Administer or order diagnostic tests, such as x-ray, electrocardiograms, and laboratory tests

Participate in patient care conferences when appropriate.

Describe the etiology and symptomatology of each selected disease process within specialty area.

Discuss current trends in management of patients with each selected disease process.

Consistently execute those aspects of the nursing care plan requiring specialized clinical expertise and skill.

Recognize and address situations and concurrent medical problems which pose a challenge to the patient.

Assist with the communication of the discharge plan to the patient and significant others.

Obtain the results of diagnostic studies and initiate further treatment in collaboration with attending physician/designee.

Consistently demonstrate commitment and accountability for the primary responsibility of providing quality patient care to a specialized group of patients.

Always demonstrate respect for the patient’s confidentiality.

Demonstrate responsiveness to the patient and family members.

Interpret medical/nursing management to the patient, family and other health care professionals.

Discuss the stages of death and dying and methods of intervention appropriate to each patient, which will enhance and ensure quality of nursing care.

Maintain awareness of new developments in specialized area of expertise.

Apply appropriate current theoretical concepts when implementing changes in medical/nursing care.

Identify the appropriate personnel to contact for specific problems.

Interact with, and appropriately involve other health professionals in patient management.

Demonstrate a working knowledge of computers/information systems.

Demonstrate competence in crisis situations.

Recognize/identify critical changes in patient’s clinical status.

Identify the clinical manifestations of an emergency situation which require immediate intervention and respond in an appropriate and timely manner.

Identify and respond appropriately to the impact of the crisis of acute illness upon the patient, family and other members of the health care team.

Perform other duties within the scope of the position

QUALIFICATIONS:

Must possess current licensure as a Nurse Practitioner in NYS. Must possess demonstrated effective communication skills both written and verbal.

Salary: $110,000 to $125,000 per year DOE
requirements: Must possess current licensure as a Nurse Practitioner in NYS.

jobs.title: Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner
jobs.summary: Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner at Berkshire Medical Center. Setting: mixed settings. Notable: new grad friendly.
jobs.description:
Child & Adolescent Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner

The Brien Center – Pittsfield, MA Affiliate of Berkshire Health Systems

The Brien Center, Berkshire County’s largest provider of community mental health and addiction services, is seeking a Child & Adolescent Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner to join our multidisciplinary behavioral health team. We welcome both new graduates and experienced psychiatric NPs who are passionate about serving children, teens, and families in a community‑based setting.

About the Brien Center

One of the largest community behavioral health organizations in Western Massachusetts

Approximately 500 employees serving residents across Berkshire County

Comprehensive services including outpatient care, residential programs, addiction treatment, and a 24/7 crisis team

Patients include individuals with serious mental illness, depression, PTSD, anxiety disorders, substance use disorders, and more

Position Highlights

Provide psychiatric evaluations and ongoing psychiatric treatment

Work with a collaborative, multidisciplinary team of clinicians, case managers, and crisis staff

Diagnose psychiatric conditions and prescribe medications

No physical exams required

Regular supervision provided by a board‑certified psychiatrist

Meaningful work supporting children and adolescents in a community‑focused environment

Life in the Berkshires

The Berkshires offer a unique blend of small‑town New England charm and big‑city cultural access:

Excellent public and private schools

Renowned music, art, theater, and museums

Year‑round outdoor recreation including skiing, hiking, and kayaking

Just two hours from Boston and New York City
requirements: Regular supervision provided by a board‑certified psychiatrist

jobs.title: Night Shift Pediatric Hospitalist NP/PA
jobs.summary: Night Shift Pediatric Hospitalist NP/PA at CaroMont Regional Medical Center. Setting: pediatric inpatient / hospitalist. Notable: nights.
jobs.description:
Night Shift Pediatric Hospitalist NP/PA Opportunity

CaroMont Regional Medical Center

Outstanding employment opportunity for a Board-Certified Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant to join a team of two (2) Pediatric Hospitalist Physicians and two (2) APPs in a thriving, independent community hospital.

Primary responsibilities include managing the Inpatient Pediatric Medicine unit in addition to admissions and consults from the Pediatric Emergency Department. This is a full-time night shift (7p-7a) opportunity scheduled in a 7on/7off rotation. Pediatric experience required.

CaroMont Regional Medical Center, an independent not for profit healthcare system, is in Gastonia, NC, less than 20 miles from Charlotte, NC. CaroMont Health with its multiple affiliates, including a 476-bed hospital, brand new satellite hospital located in Belmont, NC, a large primary care and specialty physician network (CaroMont Medical Group) and an accredited Cancer Center is fully committed to improving the health status of the community.

Each candidate will enjoy a robust compensation package including competitive base salary, transition allowance, CME, generous benefits, and malpractice coverage.

Located just minutes from an international airport and uptown Charlotte, the area offers

the amenities of any large metropolitan area, including professional sports, the performing arts and upscale shopping and dining. Those opting to reside in Gaston County will certainly enjoy the benefits of living in a small, family-oriented community with lovely neighborhoods and an excellent choice of public and private schools.
requirements: Outstanding employment opportunity for a Board-Certified Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant to join a team of two (2) Pediatric Hospitalist Physicians and two (2) APPs in a thriving, independent community hospital.

jobs.summary: Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant at CaroMont Regional Medical Center. Notable: FNP accepted.
jobs.description:
** Exciting Employment Opportunity for Advanced Practice Providers! **

Join the dynamic team at CaroMont Medical Group, located just a short drive from the vibrant city of Charlotte, NC—one of the fastest-growing cities in the nation! We are seeking Board Certified Advanced Practice Providers (NP/PA) to work across our Primary Care Service Line which includes our Family Medicine and Urgent Care Clinics.

** Position Highlights: **

Join a collaborative and supportive team environment with a strong commitment to quality care.

Deliver full-spectrum care, including Pediatrics.

Practice in modern, well-equipped facilities with access to CaroMont’s extensive resources and network.

Crosstrain and provide coverage for CaroMont Urgent Care, training provided.

Family Medicine & Urgent Care Shifts

Cover one weekend shift per month in Urgent Care

**Requirements**

Master’s or Doctoral degree from accredited NP or PA program

Board Certified FNP or PA-C

Active NC License & DEA and Active SC License & DEA

BLS/ACLS certification

** Why CaroMont? **

CaroMont Health is an independent, not-for-profit healthcare system that prides itself on delivering exceptional care through a 476-bed hospital, brand-new satellite campus in Belmont, NC which opened its doors to the public in January 2025, extensive primary care, specialty physician network, and an accredited Cancer Center. We are deeply committed to enhancing the health and well-being of our community.

** What We Offer: **

- Competitive Compensation and Benefits Package: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes a productivity bonus, CME, Paid Time Off, Generous Benefits, and Malpractice Coverage.

- Supportive administrative team and leadership

- Opportunities for professional development and growth

- Community and Lifestyle: Experience the charm of family-oriented communities with beautiful neighborhoods, top-notch public and private schools, and a strong sense of community spirit.

Just minutes away from the bustling Charlotte metro area, you’ll have access to fabulous shopping, gourmet dining, exciting professional sporting events, concerts, and cultural experiences. Plus, with Charlotte Douglas International Airport nearby, traveling is a breeze!

** Outdoor Adventures Await: **

Enjoy a four-season climate with opportunities for outdoor recreation. Lakes, mountains, and beaches are all just a short drive away, perfect for those who love to explore nature and seek adventure.

** Ready to Join Us? **

If you’re interested in bringing your skills to our team and making a positive impact in the community, we encourage you to apply today! Visit www.caromonthealth.org to start your journey with us.

Don’t miss out on this incredible opportunity to build your career while enjoying a fulfilling lifestyle in a welcoming community!
requirements: Active NC License & DEA and Active SC License & DEA

jobs.title: Advanced Practice Provider (APP) Hospitalist
jobs.summary: Advanced Practice Provider (APP) Hospitalist at Granville Health System (Granville Medical Center).
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Advanced Practice Provider (APP) Hospitalist with Granville Health System in Oxford, NC, is responsible for examining and treating patients independently within their scope of practice and in collaboration with other healthcare professionals. Granville Health System is a rural, county-based, 62-bed hospital 40-miles North of Raleigh.

This role ensures proper illness and injury care, disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. The APP Hospitalist relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals and performs a variety of tasks. The role involves providing direct inpatient care to adult patients. Participation in the hospital's safety and infection control programs is mandatory to reduce risk to employees.

• Provide direct in-patient care to adult patients.
• Responsible for providing episodic and chronic care, as well as screening and educational assistance to patients.
• Conduct inpatient and outpatient consultations in internal medicine.
• Provide quality care to patients by following the most current evidence-based guidelines and procedures of practice.
• Adhere to all institutional policies, procedures, and regulations to ensure patient safety and quality of care.
• Take part in quality assurance audits, including continuing education, and peer review.
• Participate in continuing education and training to keep abreast of current developments in the industry.
• Recognize the diversity of the patient population and treat all warmly and kindly.
• Familiarity with a variety of concepts, practices, and procedures in the field.
• Knowledge of CPT/ICD-10 coding.
• Sufficient clinical knowledge and experience to provide clinical competence and meet institutional standards of care.
• Interpersonal skills to deal harmoniously with staff, patients, and family members.
• Demonstrated ability to meet the responsibilities of the position.

Nurse Practitioner Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in area of specialty required
• Certification as a Certified Registered Nurse Practitioner (CRNP)
• State authority for advanced practice
• Familiar with a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures

Physician Assistant Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in area of specialty required
• Certification by the National Commission on Certification of Physicians Assistants (NCCPA) as a PA-C.
• State authority for advanced practice
• Familiar with a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures
requirements: Certification as a Certified Registered Nurse Practitioner (CRNP)
Certification by the National Commission on Certification of Physicians Assistants (NCCPA) as a PA-C.

jobs.title: Advanced Practice Provider PA NP Orthopedics
jobs.summary: Advanced Practice Provider PA NP Orthopedics at Granville Health System (Granville Medical Center). Setting: mixed settings.
jobs.description:
Advanced Practice Provider — Orthopedics

Location: Granville Health System, Oxford NC

About Granville Health System:

For over a century, Granville Health System has been at the forefront of quality healthcare. To cater to the evolving needs of its community, Granville Health System has extended its services throughout Granville County, ensuring convenient medical care access for its residents. The Granville Health System main campus can be found at 1010 College Street, Oxford, North Carolina. For more details, visit GHS online at www.ghsHospital.org.

About Oxford, NC

Oxford, NC is a charming and welcoming community that offers a perfect blend of small-town charm and modern convenience, making it an ideal place to live and work. Located just about 30 miles north of Durham and 40 miles from Raleigh. The region enjoys a mild, four-season climate with warm summers, crisp autumns, blooming springs, and gentle winters—perfect for enjoying the area's outdoor activities year-round. With a thriving local economy, excellent healthcare facilities, and a strong sense of community, its historic downtown, scenic parks, and proximity to the Research Triangle ensure a balanced lifestyle with both professional and personal fulfillment.

Position Overview:

The Orthopedic Advanced Practice Provider (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) is responsible for providing high-quality, patient-centered orthopedic care in collaboration with the supervising orthopedic surgeon. The APP evaluates, diagnoses, treats, and manages patients with musculoskeletal injuries and conditions in both clinic and hospital settings. The APP serves as an integral member of the orthopedic care team, supporting patient access, surgical coordination, post-operative care, patient education, and continuity of care throughout the treatment process. The APP practices within the scope of licensure, organizational policies, and evidence-based orthopedic standards while promoting exceptional patient outcomes and patient satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

Clinical Care

• Conduct comprehensive orthopedic evaluations, including obtaining medical histories, performing physical examinations, and developing treatment plans.
• Diagnose and manage acute and chronic musculoskeletal conditions under established protocols and collaborative practice agreements.
• Order and communicate diagnostic studies, including laboratory tests, X-rays, CT scans, MRI studies, and other orthopedic imaging.
• Develop and implement treatment plans, including medications, injections, splinting, bracing, casting, and rehabilitation recommendations.
• Perform office-based orthopedic procedures within scope of practice and competency.
• Evaluate and manage post-operative patients, ensuring appropriate recovery and follow-up care.
• Assist in coordinating surgical care, including pre-operative evaluations, patient education, and post-operative management.
• Collaborate closely with physical therapy, occupational therapy, primary care providers, and other specialists to coordinate patient care.
• Identify patients requiring escalation of care and collaborate with the orthopedic surgeon regarding complex clinical decisions.

Surgical Support

• Participate in surgical first-assist responsibilities as permitted by training, credentialing, and organizational policies.
• Round on hospitalized orthopedic patients as assigned.
• Assist with discharge planning and coordination of post-discharge care needs.
• Support surgical scheduling and optimization of patient readiness for procedures.

Patient Experience & Education

• Educate patients and families regarding diagnoses, treatment options, surgical procedures, recovery expectations, and preventive care.
• Promote shared decision-making and patient engagement in treatment planning.
• Address patient concerns and questions promptly and professionally.
• Contribute to patient satisfaction initiatives and service excellence standards.

Documentation & Compliance

• Complete all documentation, orders, and clinical communications accurately and within established timeframes.
• Maintain compliance with Granville Health System policies, state and federal regulations, and professional practice standards.
• Participate in quality improvement initiatives and departmental performance improvement activities.
• Maintain required licensure, certifications, and continuing education requirements.

Team Collaboration

• Foster positive working relationships with physicians, nursing staff, rehabilitation services, radiology, and support personnel.
• Participate in departmental meetings, provider meetings, and clinical education opportunities.
• Support workflow efficiency and access initiatives to improve orthopedic patient care.

Critical Competencies:

Orthopedic Clinical Expertise

• Demonstrated knowledge of orthopedic conditions, injuries, fractures, sports medicine conditions, joint disorders, and post-surgical management.
• Ability to independently evaluate and manage routine orthopedic conditions within scope of practice.

Diagnostic & Clinical Decision-Making

• Ability to formulate differential diagnoses and treatment plans utilizing evidence-based orthopedic practices.
• Competency in interpreting orthopedic imaging and diagnostic studies.

Procedural Skills

Competency in orthopedic office procedures including:

• Joint injections
• Trigger point injections
• Splinting and bracing
• Cast application and removal
• Wound assessment and management
• Suture and staple removal

Communication & Patient Education

•Ability to communicate complex medical information clearly and effectively to patients and families.

• Demonstrates professionalism, empathy, and strong interpersonal skills.

Teamwork & Collaboration

• Works effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare environment.
• Maintains productive relationships with physicians, clinical staff, and support departments.

Time Management & Productivity

• Effectively...
requirements: The APP practices within the scope of licensure, organizational policies, and evidence-based orthopedic standards while promoting exceptional patient outcomes and patient satisfaction.
Maintain required licensure, certifications, and continuing education requirements.
